notes: Five arms on one bench state each, scored with the teacher's own objective on prepared frames. Matched forward model: this is an amortisation + closed-loop-estimation result, not sim-to-real. `oracle` uses the true coefficients and is the ceiling of this bench, not an ideal bench. Per-kind rows are the claim; the cross-kind mean is not. `net_closed` round 0 is the net_probe frame.
